interaction.prompt: A defender closes on you as you enter the zone. Tap the teammate who has time and space to receive the puck.

feedback.right: Nice read. That teammate has no defender near them, so they have the time and space to take your pass and make a play.
feedback.wrong: That teammate has a defender right on their shoulder, so there is no time and no space. Your other teammate had open ice all around them. That is the better pass.

tip: Before you pass, scan for the gap: which teammate has NO opponent beside them? That player has time.
why: Every on-ice decision starts with the same question — who has time and space? The player without a defender nearby can receive, turn, and think. Find them first.
